result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-formed. One clear content defect was found: a promotional badge on the pizza restaurant card displays '–0%', which is a meaningless discount value likely caused by a missing or zero discount amount being rendered as a badge.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a badge reading '–0%'. A zero-percent discount is nonsensical to users and indicates the badge is being rendered even when the discount value is 0/null.
issues.suggestion: Only render the discount badge when the discount value is greater than 0; otherwise hide it or fall back to another relevant label (e.g. delivery fee or ETA).
